name: function-hooks
description: Function hooks for the Rasm workspace that refuse and rewrite tool calls from policy tables, redact secrets, and add skill routing context, with a finding classifier, an editor dispatch, and spoken summaries under their options

packageManager.title: Package manager
packageManager.description: Replaces npm in Bash calls with this command

speak.title: Speak turn summaries
speak.description: Speaks a one-sentence summary of each answer through the system voice

classify.title: Classify findings
classify.description: Classifies each answer at turn.complete and writes one findings/<id> row per weakness

dispatch.title: Dispatch the editor
dispatch.description: Spawns the orchestrator over the open findings or a due guidance part at session start and draws the band
